infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: SnapVault needs the camera so you can take photos and record videos inside the app.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: SnapVault needs the microphone to record audio for your videos.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: SnapVault needs access to your photo library so you can view and pick existing photos.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: SnapVault needs permission to save the photos and videos it captures to your library.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow SnapVault to use the camera so you can take photos and record videos.
plugins.microphonePermission: Allow SnapVault to use the microphone so videos can include audio.

plugins.photosPermission: Allow SnapVault to access your photo library.
plugins.savePhotosPermission: Allow SnapVault to save photos and videos to your library.

plugins.photosPermission: Allow SnapVault to pick photos from your library.
